verdict.rationale: The API reference lives under a versioned path (/docs/v3/api-reference), and a changelog shows new behaviour shipped opt-in and off by default so existing behaviour is unchanged. Both point to versioned, backward-compatible API evolution. However, the version signal comes only from URL paths, and no deprecation policy, sunset timeline or version-support guarantee is documented. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, an explicit API versioning scheme and support windows, migration guides between API versions, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: all opt-in and off by default so today's behaviour is unchanged
The endpoints pages are autogenerated and include interactive examples for testing.
